intro: Short typed questions that Agentry answers for you, with the CLI or with Jev. Every point starts off, and you decide when it moves to shadow or to active.

engine.title: Engine
engine.providerHint: Who answers the questions. The CLI is the default; Jev is an external service with your key.
engine.providerProjects: Each project can choose its own in its settings.
engine.cliHint: One housekeeping chat per request, with your account. It counts against your quota.
engine.maxCostInvalid: The limit has to be above $0 and at most ${{max}}.
engine.jevKeyHint: Saved on this machine, and the API never returns it.
engine.removeKeyBody: Points that run on Jev will go back to today's behaviour until a key is saved again.
engine.jevModelHint: Pinned so the answers do not change without telling you.
engine.privacyHint: What Jev knows about what you do.
engine.privacyTitle: What leaves your machine with Jev
engine.privacyBody: Only the state each point declares, redacted and cut to its limit, to {{host}}. You see all of it before consenting to each point. Jev keeps nothing only on the enterprise plan. With the Claude Code CLI nothing leaves.
engine.historyDaysHint: Older decisions are deleted on their own.
engine.unavailableBody: {{failed}} of the last {{total}} requests did not arrive ({{reasons}}). The last one was {{when}}. Agentry carries on with its usual behaviour and does not wait for Jev.

points.title: Decision points
points.intro: Every point starts off. In shadow the engine answers and compares with what happened, but changes nothing. A point that acts only does so when its confidence clears its threshold.
points.activeNeedsJev: An act point needs Jev to be active: the CLI gives no confidence to compare with the threshold.

consent.staleHint: The state of this point changed since you consented, so it asks again.

points.limited: Runs as shadow until it has consent.

names.flowRefineNeeded: Decide whether a card needs refining
names.flowBounce: Send the card back to the developer after QA rejects it
names.flowScopeDrift: Spot work outside the scope in a commit
names.flowCriteriaPrecheck: Check the criteria before QA starts
names.flowRestart: Requeue a run cut short by a restart
names.boardTriage: Propose type, priority and epic when a task is created
names.teamAssign: Propose the team member for a task
names.journalRelevance: Pick which journal entries go into the handover
names.assistantSources: Pick what the assistant reads first
names.orchestrationRetry: Retry or not a task that failed
names.orchestrationModel: Suggest the model for each task of the plan
names.orchestrationFixer: Decide whether to launch the fix after a failed check
names.runContinuation: Decide whether the work is still open after a result
names.supervisorIntervene: Decide whether the supervisor steps in on a stuck worker
names.healthSemanticLoop: Detect loops that do not repeat literally
names.changesUnexplainedHunk: Flag unexplained changes in a review
names.notificationUrgency: Pick the urgency of each notification
names.paletteIntent: Interpret what you type in the palette
